notes.note: Fork read bound: the history's event count and stored bytes (events plus out-of-line content) are read from SQL after authorization; past 32,000 events or 16 MiB the fork is refused with conversation_fork_history_too_large before any payload loads. api also now names the schema refusal code and the uncoded non-JSON/too-large envelopes, and the turn-ownership rule. Other claims unchanged.
